candidates.description: This vector represents demonstrative determiners and related proximal demonstrative prefixes across French and English.
This vector represents accented characters and linguistic suffixes common in European languages.
This vector represents the suffix "-ist" or variations of word endings containing the "-ist" and "-st" morphs across multiple languages.
This vector represents the cultural, culinary, and traditional aspects of human societies and tourism.
This feature vector activates strongly on French determiners and definite or possessive articles.
This vector activates strongly for subword tokens starting with or containing the syllable "hip" or closely related phonetic variants.
This vector represents the concept of causality, influence, and the capacity to produce effects or changes.
This vector activates for roots and words related to cultural heritage, societal structures, and historical artifacts.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens starting with or containing the letter 'k' or 'K' in various linguistic contexts.
These tokens represent adjectives and nouns expressing varying degrees of significance, likelihood, or scale.
